अरुणावरज: अरुणावरज m. (-जः) A name of GARUḌA. E. अरुण, अवर after, and ज born; the younger brother of ARUṆA.
अरुणित: अरुणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reddened. 2 Dyed red, impurpled. E. अरुण and इतच् aff.
अरुणिमन्: अरुणिमन् m. (-मा) Redness. E. अरुण and इमनिच् aff.
अरुणीकृत: अरुणीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reddened, turning or become red. E. अरुण, and कृत made, च्ची augment.
अरुणोदय: अरुणोदय m. (-यः) Break of day, dawn, the period preceding sunset. E. अरुण dawn, उदय rise.
अरुणोपल: अरुणोपल m. (-लः) A ruby. E. अरुण dark red, and उपल a stone.
अरुदित: अरुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unwept, unlamented. 2 Not weeping. E. अ neg. रुदित wept.
अरुद्ध: अरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Free, unobstructed. E. अ neg. रुद्ध obstructed.
अरुन्तुद: अरुन्तुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Sharp, corrosive. 2 Acrimonious, sharp, sour. (as disposition.) E. अरुस् a sore, and तुद what torments, from तुद and खश affix; the final of अरुस् is dropped, and नुम inserted.
अरुन्तुदत्व: अरुन्तुदत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Infliction of pain. 2 Acrimoniousness, causticity. E. त्व added to the last. Also अरुन्तुदता.
अरुन्धती: अरुन्धती f. (-ती) The daughter of KĀRDDAMA and wife of VASIṢṬHA, one of the seven Ṛṣis; she is also one of the Pleiades. E. अ neg. रुध to confine, तन् and ङीप् affixes; who does not confine or hinder good works. ARUNDHATĪ is considered as a pattern of conjugal excellence, and is invoked at the marriage ceremony by the bridegroom.
अरुन्धतीजानि: अरुन्धतीजानि m. (-निः) VAŚIṢṬHA, one of the seven Ṛṣis or saints, and stars in the great bear. E. अरुन्धती and जानि from जाया a wife; whose wife is ARUNDHATĪ.
अरुन्धतीनाथ: अरुन्धतीनाथ m. (-थः) A name of VASIṢṬHA, as above. E. अरुन्धती and नाथ a lord or husband.
अरुश: अरुश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Smooth, liter. or fig. E. अ neg. रुश rough.
अरुष्क: अरुष्क m. (-ष्कः) The marking-nut plant, see the next word. E. अरुस् a sore, and क what makes.
अरुष्कर: अरुष्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Corrosive, caustic, acrid. m. (-रः) The marking-nut plant, (Semecarpius anacardium.) n. (-रं) The nut. E. अरुस् a sore, कृ to make, ट aff.
अरुष्ट: अरुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Calm, not angry. E. अ neg. रुष्ट angry.
अरुस्: अरुस् mfn. (-रुः) A sore or wound. m. (-रुः) The sun. ind. A joint. E. ऋ to go, and उसि Uṇādi aff.
अरुसिका: अरुसिका f. (का) Eruptions on the scalp, with acute pain. E. अरुस् a sore, कन् added.
अरूप: अरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 1 Formless, shapeless. 2 Ugly, ill formed, misshapen. 3 Dissimilar, unlike. E. अ neg. रूप beauty.
अरूपक: अरूपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Literal, without figure or metaphor. E. अ neg. रूपक figurative.
अरूपता: अरूपता f. (-ता) 1 Ugliness. 2 Shapelessness. 3 Dissimilarity. E. तल् added to अरूप, also अरूपत्व.
अरूपवत्: अरूपवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Ugly, shapeless. E. अरूप and मतुप् aff.
अरूष: अरूष m. (-षः) 1 A kind of snake. 2 The sun. E. ऋ to go, ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.
अरे: अरे ind. Interjection of calling to inferiors.
अरेरे: अरेरे ind. 1 Interjection of calling to inferiors. 2 Also of calling angrily.
अरोक: अरोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Obscured, dimmed, darkened. E. रुच् to be light, घञ् affix; अ neg. prefix.
अरोकदत्: अरोकदत् mfn. (-दत्-दती-दत्) Having black or discoloured teeth. E. अरोक, and दत् for दन्त a tooth, also अरोकदन्त.
अरोकदन्त: अरोकदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Having bad teeth; see the last.
अरोग: अरोग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Well, healthy, free from disease. m. (-गः) Health. E. अ neg. रोग sickness.
अरोगिता: अरोगिता f. (-ता) Health. E. अरोगिन् well, तल् affix, or with त्व अरोगित्वं.
अरोगिन्: अरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Well, in health. E. अ neg. रोगिन् sick.
अरोचक: अरोचक f. (-कः) Indigestion, loss of appetite. E. अ neg. रोचक digestion.
अरोचिष्णु: अरोचिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Disagreeable. 2 Dark. 3 Ugly. E. अ neg. रोचिष्णु splendid, &c.
अरोदन: अरोदन n. (-नं) Not weeping. E. अ neg. रोदन weeping.
अरोध्य: अरोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Unobstructed, unobstructable. E. अ neg. रोध्य to be hindered.
अरोपण: अरोपण n. (-णं) Not planting or fixing. E. अ neg. रोपण setting up.
अरोष: अरोष m. (-षः) Calmness, gentleness. E. अ neg. रोष wrath.
अरौद्र: अरौद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) Not formidable or fierce. E. अ neg. रोद्र formidable.
अर्क: अर्क r. 10th cl. (अर्कयति) 1 To praise. 2 To heat or warm.

अर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 The sun. 2 Crystal. 3 Swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea.) 4 Copper. 5 A name of INDRA. 6 A Paṇḍita or learned man. 7 An elder brother. 8 Sunday. E. अर्च to worship or respect, क Uṇādi affix, and the च is dropped; what is worshipped or respected: or अर्क to heat, affix अच्.
अर्कज: अर्कज du. m. (-जौ) The two sons of SŪRYA and AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga. E. अर्क the sun, and ज who is born.
अर्कतनय: अर्कतनय m. (-यः) The son of SŪRYA or the sun, applicable to YAMA, to SANI, to the Munis VAIVASVATA and SĀVARṆI, to REVANTA, and to KARṆA. f. (-या) The daughter of the sun, applied to the river goddesses YAMUNĀ and TAPATĪ. E. अर्क, and तनय a son.
अर्कत्विष्: अर्कत्विष् f. (-त्विट्) 1 A ray of light. 2 The light of the sun. E. अर्क, and त्विष् radiance.
अर्कदिन: अर्कदिन n. (-नं) A solar day. E. अर्क, and दिन a day: also अर्कदिवसं, &c.
अर्कनन्दन: अर्कनन्दन m. (-नः) YAMA, &c. see अर्कतनय. E. as before, and नन्दन a son.
अर्कपत्र: अर्कपत्र m. (-त्रः) Swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea.) f. (-त्रा) A kind of birth wort, (Aristolochia Indica.) E. अर्क the swallow wort, and पत्र a leaf: the leaves of the two plants being similar.
अर्कपर्ण: अर्कपर्ण m. (-र्णः) Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea, or Calotropis.) E. अर्क the sun, and पर्ण a leaf.
अर्कपादप: अर्कपादप m. (-पः) The Nimb tree, (Nimba or Melia azadirachta.) E. अर्क, and पादप a tree.
अर्कपुष्पिका: अर्कपुष्पिका f. (-का) A plant, vulgarly Arkahuli, (Cleome pentaphylla). Also अर्कपुष्पी.
अर्कबन्धु: अर्कबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A name of BUDDHA, the founder of the BAUDDHA sect of Hindus. E. अर्क the sun, and बन्धु a kinsman, being of the Sūrya Van's, or line of the sun.
अर्कबान्धव: अर्कबान्धव m. (-वः) See the preceding. E. as before, बान्धव a kinsman.
अर्कमण्डल: अर्कमण्डल n. (-लं) The disc of the sun. E. अर्क, and मण्डल a circle.
अर्करेतोज: अर्करेतोज m. (-जः) REVANTA the son of SŪRYA. E. अर्क, रेतस् the semen, and ज born.
अर्कवर्ष: अर्कवर्ष m. (-षः) A solar year. E. अर्क, and वर्ष a year; also अर्कवत्सर, &c.
अर्कव्रत: अर्कव्रत n. (-तं) 1 Levying taxes, subjecting the people to heavy imposts, drawing their wealth as the sun evaporizes water. 2 Periodical worship of the sun. E. अर्क the sun, and व्रत observance.
अर्कसूनु: अर्कसूनु m. (-नुः) YAMA, regent of the dead. E. अर्क, and सूनु a son: the son of SŪRYA. See अर्कतनय.
अर्कसोदर: अर्कसोदर m. (-रः) The elephant of INDRA. E. अर्क, सोदर kinsman, from स with, and उदर womb; from their being alike engaged in maintaining the universe.
अर्कांश: अर्कांश m. (-शः) A digit or twelfth of the sun's disc. E. अर्क, and अंश a part.
अर्काश्मन्: अर्काश्मन् m. (-श्मा) 1 A crystal lens. See सूर्य्यकान्त. 2 A ruby. E. अर्क, and अश्मन् a stone.
अर्काहू: अर्काहू m. (-हूः) Swallow wort. E. अर्क, and अक्व appellation: bearing all the synonyms of the sun.
अर्केन्दुसङ्गम: अर्केन्दुसङ्गम m. (-मः) The instant of conjunction of the sun and moon. E. अर्क the sun, इन्दु the moon, and सङ्गम union.
अर्कोपल: अर्कोपल m. (-लः) 1 The sun-stone. 2 A ruby. 3 A crystal lens. E. अर्क, and उपल a stone.
अर्गल: अर्गल nf. (-लः-ला or -ली) A wooden bolt or pin for fastening a door. mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A surge or billow. E. अर्ज to gain, कलच् affix, ज becomes ग, and the fem. takes both टाप् and ङीप्.
अर्गलिका: अर्गलिका f. (-का) A small door pin, a bolt. E. as before, कन affix, टाप् for the fem. and इ substituted for अ.
अर्घ: अर्घ r. 1st cl. (अर्घति) To hurt or injure. r. 10th cl. (अर्घयति) To cost, to be worth.
अर्घ m. (र्घः) 1 Price, cost. 2 Mode of worship or reverence. 3 An oblation of various ingredients to a god or Brahman. E. अर्घ to cost, or अर्हं to worship, ह being changed to घ, affix अच्.
अर्घदान: अर्घदान n. (-नं) Presentation of a respectful offering. E. अर्घ, and दान giving.
अर्घबलाबल: अर्घबलाबल n. (-लं) Rate of price, proper price. E. अर्घ, and बल strength, अबल weakness.
अर्घसंख्यापन: अर्घसंख्यापन n. (-नं) Fixing the price of commodities, appraising, assize. E. अर्घ, and संख्यापन fixing together with: it is the act of the king or ruler, in concert with the traders, and should be done once a week or once a fortnight.
अर्घार्ह: अर्घार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Worthy of or requiring a respectful offering, a superior. E. अर्घ, and अर्ह worthy.
अर्घीश: अर्घीश m. (-शः) A name of ŚIVA. E. अर्घ oblation, and ईश lord: the lord of offerings.
अर्घ्य: अर्घ्य mfn. (-र्घ्यः-र्घ्या-र्घ्यं) Venerable, deserving worship. n. (-र्घ्यं) A respectful oblation to gods or venerable men, of rice, dūrbbā grass, flowers, &c. with water, and of water only in a small boat-shaped vessel. n. (-र्घ्यं) Wild honey. E. अर्घ, and य or यत् aff.
अर्च: अर्च r. 1st cl. (अर्चति) Also 1st and 10th cls. (अर्चति-ते अर्चयति-ते) To worship, to honour or treat with respect: with सम् prefixed, to worship. This root and its derivatives are also read अर्च्च, &c. doubling the consonant after र.
अर्चक: अर्चक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A worshipper, one who worships. E. अर्च and वुन् aff.
अर्चना: अर्चना mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) An article of worship. nf. (-नं-ना) Worship, the homage paid to deities and to superiors. E. अर्च to worship, युच् and टाप् aff.
अर्चनीय: अर्चनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Venerable, respectable. E. अर्च, and अनीयर् affix, also अर्च्य and अर्चयितव्य.
अर्चा: अर्चा f. (-र्चा) 1 Worship, see अर्चना. 2 An image. E. अर्च to worship, अच् affix, and टाप् fem. do.
अर्चि: अर्चि f. (-र्चिः) Flame. E. अर्च to worship, इन् aff.
अर्चित: अर्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Worshipped, respected, saluted. E. अर्च in the part. past.
अर्चिष्मत्: अर्चिष्मत् mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मती-ष्मत्) Brilliant, resplendent. m. (-ष्मान्) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. E. अर्चिस् flame, and मतुप poss. aff.
अर्चिस्: अर्च्चिस् m. (-र्चिः) 1 Flame. 2 A ray of light. 3 Light, lustre. E. अर्च to worship, and इसि Uṇādi aff.
अर्च्चिस्: अर्च्चिस् m. (-र्चिः) 1 Flame. 2 A ray of light. 3 Light, lustre. E. अर्च to worship, and इसि Uṇādi aff.
अर्च्य: अर्च्य mfn. (-र्च्यः-र्च्या-र्च्यं) Reverend, respectable, worshipful. E. अर्च to worship, and यत् aff.
अर्ज: अर्ज r. 1st cl. (अर्जति) To earn, to gain or acquire, (commonly used with उप prefixed.) 10th cl. (अर्जयति) 1 The same, and: 2 To work or manufacture. 3 To make or prepare. This root and its derivatives are also read अर्ज्ज, &c. doubling the consonant after र.
अर्जक: अर्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An acquirer, one who gains or acquires. m. (-कः) Basil, the white sort, (Ocymum villosum.) E. अर्ज to gain, and वुन् aff.
अर्जन: अर्जन n. (-नं) Gain, acquisition of wealth, &c. E. अर्ज, and ल्युट् affix, also written अर्ज्जन.
अर्जित: अर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained, acquired. E. अर्ज to gain, क्त affix, also written अर्ज्जित.
अर्जुन: अर्जुन m. (-नः) 1 The third of the Pāṇḍavas, the son of INDRA and friend of KṚṢṆA. 2 The name of a king with a thousand arms. See कार्त्तवीर्य्य. 3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 4 A peacock. 5 The only son of his mother. 6 White, (the colour.) nf. (-नं-नी) 1 Grass. 2 Slight inflammation of the conjunctiva or white of the eye. f. (-नी) 1 A cow. 2 UṢĀ, the wife of ANIRUDDHA. 3 The Karatoya river in the north of Bengal. 4 A procuress, a bawd. mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) White. E. अर्ज to gain, उनन् Uṇādi affix, fem. ङीप्, also read अर्ज्जुन.
अर्जुनक: अर्जुनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Belonging to ARJUNA. E. अर्जुन and वुन् aff.
अर्जुनतस्: अर्जुनतस् ind. On the side or party of ARJUNA. E. अर्जुन and तसि aff.
अर्जुनच्छवि: अर्जुनच्छवि mfn. (-विः-विः-वि) White, of a white colour. E. अर्जुन white, and छवि light.
अर्जुनध्वज: अर्जुनध्वज m. (-जः) The monkey HANUMĀN. E. अर्जुन, and ध्वज a banner, being ARJUNA'S symbol.
अर्जुनोपम: अर्जुनोपम m. (-मः) The teak tree, (Tectona grandis.) E. अर्जुन a tree, &c. उपम like.
अर्ण: अर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 The teak tree. 2 A letter.
अर्णव: अर्णव m. (-वः) The ocean. E. अर्णस् water, व affix, and स is dropped: the ण in this and similar words is optionally doubled, as अर्ण्णव, &c.
अर्णवज: अर्णवज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Sea-born, marine. mn. (-जः-जं) Cuttle fish. E. अर्णव, and ज born.
अर्णवमन्दिर: अर्णवमन्दिर m. (-रः) VARUṆA, regent of the water. E. अर्णव the ocean, and मन्दिर a house; whose dwelling is the deep.
अर्णवपोत: अर्णवपोत m. (-तः) A boat or ship. E. अर्णव, and पोत a boat.
अर्णवयान: अर्णवयान n. (-नं) A boat or ship. E. अर्णव, and यान vehicle.
अर्णस्: अर्णस् n. (-र्णः) Water. E. ऋ to go, असुन् Uṇādi affix, and नट् inserted.
अर्णोद: अर्णोद m. (-दः) A cloud. E. अर्णस्, and द what gives.
अर्णोभव: अर्णोभव m. (-वः) A shell. E. अर्णस्, and भव being.
अर्तगल: अर्त्तगल m. (-लः) Blue barleria, (B. caerulea.) E. आर्त्त exhausted, and गल to drop, the आ is made short, also आर्तगल.
अर्त्तगल: अर्त्तगल m. (-लः) Blue barleria, (B. caerulea.) E. आर्त्त exhausted, and गल to drop, the आ is made short, also आर्तगल.
अर्तन: अर्त्तन n. (-नं) Censure, reproach, abuse. E. ऋति to blame, a sautra root, and ल्युट् aff.
अर्त्तन: अर्त्तन n. (-नं) Censure, reproach, abuse. E. ऋति to blame, a sautra root, and ल्युट् aff.
अर्ति: अर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Pain. 2 The end of a bow. E. अर्द to hurt, and क्तिन् aff.
अर्त्ति: अर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Pain. 2 The end of a bow. E. अर्द to hurt, and क्तिन् aff.
अर्त्तिक: अर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Diseased, pained. m. (-कः) A kind of cake. E. अर्त्ति pain, and कन् added.
अर्तिका: अर्त्तिका f. (-का) An elder sister, (in theatrical language.) See अत्तिका.
अर्त्तिका: अर्त्तिका f. (-का) An elder sister, (in theatrical language.) See अत्तिका.
अर्थ: अर्थ r. 10th cl. (अर्थयते sometimes- ति) To ask or beg.

अर्थ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Rich. 2 Learned. m. (-र्थः) 1 Wealth, property, substance. 2 Meaning, signification. 3 Thing. 4 Fruit, consequence. 5 Prohibition. 6 A material substance or object of sense. 7 Cause, origin. 8 Request, asking, begging. 9 Kind, sort, manner. 10 Well, well being. 11 (In law) A suit, an action. E. ऋ to go, and थन् Uṇādi aff.
अर्थकर: अर्थकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Producing or yielding wealth, what enriches. E. अर्थ, and कर what makes, also similar compounds, as अर्थकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं,) अर्थकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) and अर्थजनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं,) &c.
अर्थकाम: अर्थकाम m. (-मः) Avarice, desire of wealth, E. अर्थ, and काम desire.
अर्थगरीयस्: अर्थगरीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Significant, meaning. E. अर्थ with गुरु heavy, ईयसुन superlative aff.
अर्थघ्न: अर्थघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Wasteful, extravagant. E. अर्थ, and घ्न who or what destroys.
अर्थज्ञ: अर्थज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Wise, discriminating, understanding the various significations of a word, &c. E. अर्थ meaning, and ज्ञ who knows.
अर्थतस्: अर्थतस् ind. According to the sense. E. तसि added to अर्थ.
अर्थतत्त्व: अर्थतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) Truth, the real object, nature or cause of any thing. E. अर्थ, and तत्त्व truth.
अर्थद: अर्थद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Liberal, munificent. 2 Compliant, favourable. E. अर्थ wealth or object, and द who or what gives. Also similar compounds, as अर्थदायक, अर्थदायिन् and अर्थदातृ, &c.
अर्थदूषण: अर्थदूषण n. (-णं) Waste, prodigality, extravagance. E. अर्थ, and दूषण spoiling.
अर्थना: अर्थना f. (-ना) Begging, asking. E. अर्थ to ask, and युच् aff.
अर्थपति: अर्थपति m. (-तिः) 1 KUVERA, the Hindu PLUTUS. 2 A king. E. अर्थ wealth, and पति lord.
अर्थपर: अर्थपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Intent on gaining wealth. 2 Parsimonious, niggardly. E. अर्थ, and पर intent.
अर्थप्रयोग: अर्थप्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Application of wealth, as to trade, usury, &c. 2 The profession of usury. E. अर्थ, and प्रयोग application.
अर्थप्राप्ति: अर्थप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Acquisition of wealth. 2 Attainment of an object. E. अर्थ, and प्राप्ति gaining.
अर्थभृत: अर्थभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) A servant who has high wages. E. अर्थ, and भृत maintained.
अर्थभेद: अर्थभेद m. (-दः) Distinction, difference of meaning. E. अर्थ meaning, and भेद dividing.
अर्थलाभ: अर्थलाभ m. (-भः) Acquisition of wealth. E. अर्थ, and लाभ acquiring.
अर्थलुब्ध: अर्थलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Greedy of wealth, covetous, niggardly. E. अर्थ, and लुब्ध desirous.
अर्थलेश: अर्थलेश m. (-शः) A little wealth. E. अर्थ, and लेश a little.
अर्थलोभ: अर्थलोभ m. (-भः) Avarice, desire of wealth. E. अर्थ, and लोभ desire.
अर्थवत्: अर्थवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Wealthy, rich. 2 Significant, having sense or meaning. 3 Designed, intentional, having an object. E. अर्थ, and मतुप् poss. aff.
अर्थवाद: अर्थवाद m. (-दः) 1 Praise, eulogium. 2 Declaration of purpose or object, speech or expression having a certain object, as स्तुत्यर्थवादः speech implying praise, निन्दार्थवादः speech implying censure. 3 Amplification. E. अर्थ substance, thing, and वाद speaking.
अर्थविज्ञान: अर्थविज्ञान n. (-नं) One of the six exercises of the understanding, the comprehension of meanings. E. अर्थ meaning, import, and विज्ञान knowledge.
अर्थविद्: अर्थविद् mfn. (-वित् or -विद्) Sagacious, sensible, wise. E. अर्थ, and विद् who knows.
अर्थवृद्धि: अर्थवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Accumulation of wealth. E. अर्थ, and वृद्धि increase.
अर्थवैकल्प: अर्थवैकल्प n. (-ल्पं) Prevarication, evasion, deviation from truth, perversion or disguise of fact. E. अर्थ object, वैकल्प alteration.
अर्थव्यय: अर्थव्यय m. (-यः) Expenditure. E. अर्थ, and व्यय expenditure.
अर्थव्ययज्ञ: अर्थव्ययज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Liberal in giving and using. E. अर्थ wealth, व्यय expense, and ज्ञ who knows.
अर्थशास्त्र: अर्थशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The science of polity or moral and political government. E. अर्थ possession, property, and शास्त्र institutes of a science.
अर्थशौच: अर्थशौच n. (-चं) 1 Honesty. 2 Acquisition of wealth. E. अर्थ purpose or wealth, शौच purity.
अर्थसंग्रह: अर्थसंग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Accumulation of wealth. 2 A treasure. E. अर्थ, and संग्रह a collection.
अर्थसंस्थान: अर्थसंस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Accumulation of wealth. 2 A treasury. E. अर्थ, and संस्थान assemblage.
अर्थसञ्चय: अर्थसञ्चय m. (-यः) Accumulation of wealth. E. अर्थ, and सञ्चय heap.
अर्थसम्बन्ध: अर्थसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) Connexion of the sense with the word or sentence. E. अर्थ, and सम्बन्ध connexion.
अर्थसिद्ध: अर्थसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Effected by wealth. 2 Successful, one whose aim is accomplished. E. अर्थ, and सिद्ध accomplished.
अर्थसिद्धि: अर्थसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Success. E. अर्थ, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
अर्थहर: अर्थहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Inheriting or taking wealth. E. अर्थ, and हर who takes. So अर्थहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि.)
अर्थहीन: अर्थहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Poor. 2 Failing, disappointed. 3 Unmeaning, nonsensical. E. अर्थ, and हीन wanting. So अर्थशून्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) E. अर्थ, and शून्य empty.
अर्थागम: अर्थागम m. (-मः) 1 Receipt or collection of property. 2 Acquisition of wealth. E. अर्थ wealth, and आगम coming.
अर्थाधिकार: अर्थाधिकार m. (-रः) Stewardship, treasurership, charge of money or property. E. अर्थ, and अधिकार superintendence.
अर्थाधिकारिन्: अर्थाधिकारिन् m. (-री) A treasurer, a paymaster. E. अर्थ, and अधिकारिन् superintendent.
अर्थान्तर: अर्थान्तर n. (-रं) 1 Difference of meaning or purport. 2 Another or second sense. 3 Opposite or antithetical meaning. E. अर्थ, and अन्तर difference.
अर्थान्तरन्यास: अर्थान्तरन्यास m. (-सः) Antithesis. E. अर्थान्तर, and न्यास position.
अर्थान्वित: अर्थान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rich. 2 Significant. E. अर्थ wealth, and अन्वित possessed of.
अर्थापत्ति: अर्थापत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 A figure of speech, a quibble, the use of one word in a double sense. 2 An inference from circumstances. E. अर्थ, and आपत्ति gaining.
अर्थार्थिन्: अर्थार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 1 One who solicits wealth. 2 One endeavouring to gain any object. E. अर्थ, and अर्थिन who seeks or solicits.
अर्थिक: अर्थिक m. (-कः) 1 A crier, a watchman, a minstrel, a servant whose duty it is to announce by song or music, fixed periods of the day, or those of getting up and of repose, &c. 2 A beggar, a solicitor. E. अर्थि a rich man, and क from के to call or sound.
अर्थित: अर्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asked, begged, sought. E. अर्थ to ask, क्त aff.
अर्थिता: अर्थिता f. (-ता) Asking, begging. Also n. (-त्वं) E. तल् or त्व added to अर्थिन्.
अर्थिन्: अर्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 1 One who asks or begs for any thing. 2 One who seeks to effect or gain a purpose or object. m. (-र्थी) 1 A servant. 2 A follower, a companion or partisan. 3 A plaintiff, a prosecutor. 4 A beggar, a petitioner. E. अर्थ asking, &c. इनि aff.
अर्थोपार्जन: अर्थोपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquiring wealth. E. अर्थ, and उपार्ज्जन acquiring.
अर्थोपार्ज्जन: अर्थोपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquiring wealth. E. अर्थ, and उपार्ज्जन acquiring.
अर्थोष्मन्: अर्थोष्मन् n. (-ष्म) Wealth, the condition of being wealthy. E. अर्थ, and उष्मन् warmth. So, anglice, a warm man.
अर्थ्य: अर्थ्य mfn. (-र्थ्यः-र्थ्या-र्थ्यं) 1 Intelligent, wise. 2 Wealthy. 3 Right, proper. 4 Fit to be asked or sought. n. (-र्थ्यं) Red chalk. E. अर्थ and यत् aff.
अर्द: अर्द r. 1st cl. (अर्दति) 1 To ask or beg. 2 To go. 1st and 10th cls. (अर्दति-ते अर्दयति-ते) To kill or to hurt.
अर्दना: अर्दना f. (-ना) 1 Begging, asking. 2 Giving pain. 3 Killing. 4 Going. E. अर्द to ask, &c. युच् and टाप् affs.
अर्दनि: अर्दनि m. (-निः) 1 Fire. 2 Asking, begging. 3 Sickness, disease. E. अर्द to pain, इनि aff.
अर्दित: अर्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Asked, requested, begged. 2 Killed, injured. 3 Pained, afflicted. 4 Gone. n. (-तं) A disease, Hemiplegia, paralysis of the muscles on one side of the face and neck. E. अर्द to go, to ask, &c. affix, क्त and इट् inserted.
अर्द्ध: अर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) Half, halved. m. (-र्द्धं) A part. n. (-र्द्धं) A half. E. ऋध to increase, and घञ् aff.
अर्द्धकृत: अर्द्धकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Halved, divided equally. E. अर्द्ध, and कृत made.
अर्द्धखार: अर्द्धखार nf. (-रं-री) A measure, half a khārī. E. अर्द्धं, and खारी a measure so called.
अर्द्धगङ्गा: अर्द्धगङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Kāverī river, in the peninsula. E. अर्द्ध half, and गङ्गा the Ganges; being a sacred stream, having half the virtues of the great Ganges.
अर्द्धगुच्छ: अर्द्धगुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A necklace of twenty-four strings. E. अर्द्ध, and गुच्छ a bundle.
अर्द्धचन्द्र: अर्द्धचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A crescent or half moon. 2 The hand bent into a semicircle or the shape of a claw, as for the purpose of seizing or clutching any thing. 3 The semicircular marks on a peacock's tail. 4 An arrow, with a head like a crescent. 5 The semicircular scratch of the finger nail. f. (-न्द्रा) A plant, vulgarly Teori, the black kind. E. अर्द्ध half, and चन्द्र moon, or with कन् added अर्द्धचन्द्रकः.
अर्द्धचन्द्राकार: अर्द्धचन्द्राकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Of the shape of the half moon. m. (रः) A meniscus. E. अर्द्धचन्द्र, and आकार form.
अर्द्धचन्द्राकृति: अर्द्धचन्द्राकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Half mooned, of a crescent-shape, convex and concave. f. (-तिः) A meniscus. E. अर्द्धचन्द्र, and आकृति shape.
अर्द्धचोलक: अर्द्धचोलक m. (-कः) A short bodice. E. अर्द्ध, and चोलक a bodice.
अर्द्धजाह्नवी: अर्द्धजाह्नवी f. (-वी) The Kāverī river. See अर्द्धगङ्ग, जाह्नवी being the Ganges.
अर्द्धधार: अर्द्धधार n. (रं) A knife or lancet with a single edge, the blade two inches long, the heft six. E. अर्द्ध, and धारा an edge.
अर्द्धनारीश: अर्द्धनारीश m. (-शः) A name of MAHĀDEVA. E. अर्द्ध, नारी a woman, and ईश master; one of the forms of ŚIVA, to which this name applies, being half male and half female.
अर्द्धनाव: अर्द्धनाव m. (-वः) A boat's half. E. अर्द्ध, and नाव, from नौ a boat, and टच् aff.
अर्द्धनिशा: अर्द्धनिशा f. (-शा) Midnight. E. अर्द्ध, and निशा night.
अर्द्धपण: अर्द्धपण n. (-णं) Half a Paṇa. E. अर्द्ध, and पण a measure of four Kākiṇīs.
अर्द्धपारावत: अर्द्धपारावत m. (-तः) 1 A pigeon, (with a spotted or painted throat.) 2 The francoline partridge. E. अर्द्ध, and पारावत a pigeon.
अर्द्धपुलायित: अर्द्धपुलायित n. (-तं) A half gallop, a canter. E. अर्द्ध, and पुलायित a gallop.
अर्द्धप्रहर: अर्द्धप्रहर m. (-रः) Half a watch, a period of an hour and a half. E. अर्द्ध, and प्रहर a watch.
अर्द्धभाग: अर्द्धभाग m. (-गः) A half. E. अर्द्ध, and भाग part.
अर्द्धभाज्: अर्द्धभाज् mf. (भाक्) Taking or sharing half. E. अर्द्ध half, and भाज who possesses.
अर्द्धभागिक: अर्द्धभागिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Taking or sharing half. E. अर्द्धभाग a half, ठक aff.
अर्द्धभागिन्: अर्द्धभागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Sharing or taking half. E. अर्द्धभाग and इनि aff.
अर्द्धमाणव: अर्द्धमाणव m. (-वः) A necklace of twelve strings. Also अर्द्धमाणवक. E. अर्द्ध, and माणव one of twenty-four strings.
अर्द्धयाम: अर्द्धयाम m. (-मः) Half a watch, an hour and a half. E. अर्द्ध, and याम a watch, also अर्द्धयामक.
अर्द्धरथ: अर्द्धरथ m. (-थः) A warrior, who fights on a car with another. E. अर्द्ध, and रथ a car, having half a car.
अर्द्धरात्र: अर्द्धरात्र m. (-त्रः) 1 Midnight. 2 The period from two and a half to three and a half watches of the night. E. अर्द्ध, and रात्र night.
अर्द्धर्च: अर्द्धर्च mn. (-र्चः-र्चं) Half a verse of the Vedas. E. अर्द्ध, and ऋच् a verse of a Veda.
अर्द्धवीक्षण: अर्द्धवीक्षण n. (-णं) A side look, a glance, a leer. E. अर्द्ध, and वीक्षण looking.
अर्द्धशत: अर्द्धशत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fifty. 2 One hundred and fifty. E. अर्द्ध, and शत a hundred, in the second sense it is more usually सार्द्ध शत, &c. So अर्द्धपञ्चाशत्, अर्द्धसहस्र, &c.
अर्द्धशन: अर्द्धशन n. (-नं) Half a meal. E. अर्द्ध, and अशन eating, also अर्द्धाशन.
अर्द्धसफर: अर्द्धसफर m. (-रः) A small fish, (Cyprinus sophore, HAM:) E. अर्द्ध, and सफर another fish, to which it is compared.
अर्द्धसीरिन्: अर्द्धसीरिन् m. (-री) A cultivator, a ploughman who takes half the crop for his labour. E. अर्द्ध, and सीर a plough, इनि aff.
अर्द्धहार: अर्द्धहार m. (-रः) A necklace of sixty-four strings. E. अर्द्ध, and हार a necklace.
अर्द्धांश: अर्द्धांश m. (-शः) A half. E. अर्द्ध, and अंश a share.
अर्द्धांशिन्: अर्द्धांशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Sharing a half. E. अर्द्धांश and इनि aff.
अर्द्धाङ्ग: अर्द्धाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गः) Half the body. E. अर्द्ध, and अङ्ग the body.
अर्द्धार्द्ध: अर्द्धार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) Sharing equally. m. (-र्द्धः) A quarter. E. अर्द्ध repeated.
अर्द्धावभेदक: अर्द्धावभेदक m. (-कः) Pain of half the head, hemicrania. n. (-कं) Dividing in equal parts. E. अर्द्ध, and अवभेदक cutting off.
अर्द्धाशन: अर्द्धाशन n. (-नं) Half a meal. Also अर्द्धशन.
अर्द्धासन: अर्द्धासन n. (-नं) 1 Exemption from censure. 2 Greeting kindly or with respect, placing on the same seat. E. अर्द्ध, and आस to remain, affix ल्युट्.
अर्द्धिक: अर्द्धिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Measuring a half. 2 Relating to a half. E. अर्द्ध and टिठन aff.
अर्द्धिन्: अर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिणी-र्द्धि) Entitled to or sharing a half. E. अर्द्ध and इनि aff.
अर्द्धेन्दु: अर्द्धेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 A half moon or crescent. 2 The impression of a finger nail. 3 The hand expanded in a semicircular form like a claw. 4 An arrow with a crescent-shaped head. E. अर्द्धे, and इन्दु the moon.
अर्द्धोक्त: अर्द्धोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Half uttered, said imperfectly or indistinctly. E. अर्द्ध, and उक्त said.
अर्द्धोक्ति: अर्द्धोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Speaking indistinctly or incompletely, broken or interrupted speech. E. अर्द्ध, and उक्ति speech.
अर्द्धोदित: अर्द्धोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Half risen. 2 Half uttered. E. अर्द्ध, and उदित risen.
अर्द्धोरुक: अर्द्धोरुक n. (-कं) A short petticoat. E. अर्द्ध, and उरु the thigh, कन् aff.
अर्पण: अर्पण nf. (-णं-णा) 1 Delivering, entrusting. 2 Placing in or upon. E. ऋ to go, in the causal form, युच् aff.
अर्पणीय: अर्पणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be delivered, deliverable. E. ऋ to go, causal form, अनीयर aff.
अर्पित: अर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Delivered, consigned. 2 Placed in or upon. E. ऋ to go, in the causal form, क्त aff.
अर्पितकर: अर्पितकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Extending or giving the hand. 2 Married. E. अर्पित, and कर the hand.
अर्पिस: अर्पिस m. (-सः) The heart. E. ऋ to go, in the causal form अर्प, and इसन् Uṇādi aff.
अर्प्य: अर्प्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be delivered, consignable. E. ऋ to go, causal form, य aff.
अर्ब: अर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (अर्ब्बति) 1 To go, to go to towards. 2 To kill or hurt. See अर्व्व.
अर्ब्ब: अर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (अर्ब्बति) 1 To go, to go to towards. 2 To kill or hurt. See अर्व्व.
अर्बुद: अर्ब्बुद mn. (-दः-दं) 1 Ophthalmia. 2 A hundred millions. m. (-दः) 1 The name of a mountain in the west of India, commonly Abū, a place of pilgrimage, especially to the Jains. 2 An indolent swelling. E. अर्ब to injure, उदच् affix; the root and derivative are also written with the dental letter.
अर्ब्बुद: अर्ब्बुद mn. (-दः-दं) 1 Ophthalmia. 2 A hundred millions. m. (-दः) 1 The name of a mountain in the west of India, commonly Abū, a place of pilgrimage, especially to the Jains. 2 An indolent swelling. E. अर्ब to injure, उदच् affix; the root and derivative are also written with the dental letter.
अर्भ: अर्भ mfn. (-र्भः-र्भा-र्भं) Destitute of splendour. m. (-र्भः) 1 A child, a pupil. 2 Dew. 3 Herbs. E. ऋ to go, and भन् Uṇādi aff.
अर्भक: अर्भक m. (-कः) 1 A child, the young of any animal. 2 A fool, an idiot. 3 Small, minute. 4 Emaciated. 5 Like, similar. E. ऋध to grow, वुन् Uṇādi affix, and भ substituted for ध.
अर्म: अर्म्म mn. (-र्मः-र्मं) A disease of the eyes. E. ऋ to go, and मन Uṇādi affix, also read अर्म्मन्.
अर्म्म: अर्म्म mn. (-र्मः-र्मं) A disease of the eyes. E. ऋ to go, and मन Uṇādi affix, also read अर्म्मन्.
अर्मण: अर्म्मण m. (-णः) A measure of one Droṇa.
अर्म्मण: अर्म्मण m. (-णः) A measure of one Droṇa.
अर्मन्: अर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) A disease of the eyes. E. ऋ to go, मनिन् aff.
अर्म्मन्: अर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) A disease of the eyes. E. ऋ to go, मनिन् aff.
अर्य: अर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Excellent. m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A master. 2 A man of the third tribe, the Vaiśya. f. (-र्य्यः) 1 A woman of the third tribe. 2 The wife of a Vaiśya. E. ऋ to go, यत् affix, and टाप् or ङीप् for the fem.; ङीष् is affixed, when the word is fem. with reference to the male.
अर्य्य: अर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Excellent. m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A master. 2 A man of the third tribe, the Vaiśya. f. (-र्य्यः) 1 A woman of the third tribe. 2 The wife of a Vaiśya. E. ऋ to go, यत् affix, and टाप् or ङीप् for the fem.; ङीष् is affixed, when the word is fem. with reference to the male.
अर्यमन्: अर्य्यमन् m. (-मा) 1 The sun. 2 A class of the Manes or deified progenitors. 3 The asclepias plant. E. ऋ to go, कनिन् Uṇādi affix, and माङ् inserted.
अर्य्यमन्: अर्य्यमन् m. (-मा) 1 The sun. 2 A class of the Manes or deified progenitors. 3 The asclepias plant. E. ऋ to go, कनिन् Uṇādi affix, and माङ् inserted.
अर्य्यर्य्याणी: अर्य्यर्य्याणी f. (-णी) A multitude of women of the Vaiśya tribe.
अर्याणी: अर्य्याणी f. (-णी) A woman of the Vaiśya tribe. E. अर्य्य, ङीप् affix, and आनुक inserted. See अर्य्य.
अर्य्याणी: अर्य्याणी f. (-णी) A woman of the Vaiśya tribe. E. अर्य्य, ङीप् affix, and आनुक inserted. See अर्य्य.
अर्व: अर्व्व r. 1st cl. (अर्व्वति) To kill or hurt, also written अर्ब्ब.
अर्व्व: अर्व्व r. 1st cl. (अर्व्वति) To kill or hurt, also written अर्ब्ब.
अर्वट: अर्व्वट n. (-टं) Ashes. E. अर्व्व or अर्ब्ब to injure, hence the word may be also written अर्ब्बट.
अर्व्वट: अर्व्वट n. (-टं) Ashes. E. अर्व्व or अर्ब्ब to injure, hence the word may be also written अर्ब्बट.
अर्वन्: अर्व्वन् mfn. (-र्व्वा-र्व्वती-र्व्वत्) Low, inferior, vile. m. (-र्व्वा) 1 A horse. 2 A name of INDRA. 3 A short span. f. (-र्वती) 1 A mare. 2 A bawd, a procuress. E. ऋ to go, and वनिप् Uṇādi affix; it is sometimes derived from अर्ब्ब to go, and is then written अर्ब्बन्.
अर्व्वन्: अर्व्वन् mfn. (-र्व्वा-र्व्वती-र्व्वत्) Low, inferior, vile. m. (-र्व्वा) 1 A horse. 2 A name of INDRA. 3 A short span. f. (-र्वती) 1 A mare. 2 A bawd, a procuress. E. ऋ to go, and वनिप् Uṇādi affix; it is sometimes derived from अर्ब्ब to go, and is then written अर्ब्बन्.
अर्वाच्: अर्व्वाच् mfn. (-वाङ्-वाची-वाक्) Following, subsequent. ind. (वाच् or वाक्) 1 After, in time. 2 Behind, in place. 3 Near. E. अवर behind, अञ्च to go, and क्विप् affix; the formation is irregular.
अर्व्वाच्: अर्व्वाच् mfn. (-वाङ्-वाची-वाक्) Following, subsequent. ind. (वाच् or वाक्) 1 After, in time. 2 Behind, in place. 3 Near. E. अवर behind, अञ्च to go, and क्विप् affix; the formation is irregular.
अर्वाचीन: अर्व्वाचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Reverse, contrary. 2 Recent, modern. E. अर्व्वाच् and ख aff.
अर्व्वाचीन: अर्व्वाचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Reverse, contrary. 2 Recent, modern. E. अर्व्वाच् and ख aff.
अर्व्वाचीनत्व: अर्व्वाचीनत्व n. (-त्वं) State of reverse. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, अर्व्वाचीनता.
अर्श: अर्श n. (-र्शं) Hoemorrhoids, piles. Also अर्शस.
अर्शस्: अर्शस् n. (-र्शः) Hoemorrhoids, piles. E. ऋ to go, असुन् Uṇādi affix, and शुट् inserted.
अर्शस: अर्शस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Afflicted with hoemorrhoids. E. अर्शस् and अच् aff.
अर्शसान: अर्शसान m. (-नः) Fire. E. ऋ to go, शानच् affix, and शुट् inserted.
अर्शिन्: अर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Afflicted with hoemorrhoids. E. अश, and इनि aff.
अर्शोघ्न: अर्शोघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) Destroying the hoemorrhoids. m. (-घ्नः) An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.) f. (-घ्नी) A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.) E. अर्शस्, and घ्न what destroys, from हन to kill.
अर्शोरोग: अर्शोरोग m. (-गः) The piles or hoemorrhoids. E. अर्शस, and रोग disease.
अर्शोरोगयुत: अर्शोरोगयुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Afflicted with hoemorrhoids. E. अर्शोरोग, and युत affected by.
अर्शोरोगिन्: अर्शोरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Having hoemorrhoids. E. अर्शोरोग and इनि aff.
अर्शोहित: अर्शोहित m. (-तः) The marking-nut plant, (Semecarpus anacardium.) E. अर्शस्, and हित proper.
अर्ह: अर्ह r. 1st cl. (अर्हति) 1 To worship or honour. 2 To be fit or worthy: in the first sense it is also r. 10th cl. (अर्हयति.)
अर्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) 1 Proper, fit, becoming. 2 Deserving, entitled to, worthy. m. (-र्हः) INDRA. f. (-र्हा) Worship. E. अर्ह to worship, to be fit, अच् aff.
अर्हण: अर्हण nf. (-णं-णा) Worship, adoration, respect, courtesy, treating with veneration or respect. E. अर्ह to worship, and युच् aff.
अर्हत्: अर्हत् mfn. (-न्-न्ती-त्) 1 Venerable, respectable. 2 Praised, celebrated. m. (-न्) 1 A Jina or Jaina saint and teacher. 2 A Jain or follower of the doctrines of Jina. 3 A religious mendicant of that sect. E. अर्ह to worship, &c. and शतृ affix, of the present participle.
अर्हत्तम: अर्हत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Best, most worthy. E. अर्हन् respectable, डतम aff.
अर्हत्तर: अर्हत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) More worthy, better. E. अर्हत् and डत्तर aff.
अर्हन्त: अर्हन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A Saugata or follower of the doctrines of Buddha. 2 A religious mendicant of the same sect. 3 A name of ŚIVA. E. अर्ह to worship, &c. and अन्त irregular aff.
अर्हित: अर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Saluted, honoured, worshipped. E. अह to worship, &c. and क्त aff.
अर्ह्य: अर्ह्य mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं) Venerable, respectable, right, fit. E. अह and यत् affix: also with अनीयर affix, अर्हणीय.
अल: अल r. 1st cl. also read अलं (अलति-ते) 1 To adorn. 2 To be competent or able. 3 To prevent.
अल n. (-लं) 1 The sting in the tail of the scorpion. 2 Yellow orpiment. E. अल to adorn, &c. and अच् aff.
अलक: अलक mn. (-कः-कं) A curl. m. (-कः) A mad dog. See अलर्क. f. (-का) 1 Alakā, the capital of KUVERA. 2 A young girl from eight to ten years of age. E. अल to adorn, &c. वुन् affix, and fem. टाप्.
अलकनन्दा: अलकनन्दा f. (-न्दा) 1 A young girl from eight to ten years old. 2 A river, the Alakanandā, a stream that runs from the Himālaya mountains, and falls into the Ganges near Srīnagar. It is also a name of the terrestrial Ganges. E. अलका, and नन्दा who delights, the final of the first dropped.
अलकप्रभा: अलकप्रभा f. (-भा) The capital of KUVERA. E. अलका and प्रभा what shines.
अलकसंहति: अलकसंहति f. (-तिः) Rows of curls. E. अलक, and संहति collection. So अलकावली.
अलकाधिप: अलकाधिप m. (-पः) A name of KUVERA. E. अलका the city, and अधिप a ruler.
अलकाधिपति: अलकाधिपति m. (-तिः) KUVERA. E. लका, and अधिपति ruler.
अलकान्त: अलकान्त m. (-न्तः) A ringlet, the end of a curl. E. अलक, and अन्त end.
अलक्त: अलक्त m. (-क्तः) Lac, the red animal dye so called. E. अ neg. रक्त red, र being changed to ल; than what nothing is redder.
अलक्तक: अलक्तक n. (-कं) Lac, the dye; see the preceding. E. as before, कन् being added.
अलक्तरस: अलक्तरस m. (-सः) Liquefied lac dye. E. अलक्त, and रस juice.
अलक्षण: अलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Unfortunate, ill fated, having no good marks on the person. 2 Undefined. n. (-णं) 1 The absence of auspicious marks. 2 Misfortune. 3 The want of any predicate or definition. E. अ priv. and लक्षण a mark.
अलक्षित: अलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unmarked, having no particular mark. 2 Unobserved, unseen. 3 Undefined. E. अ neg. and लक्षित marked.
अलक्ष्मी: अलक्ष्मी f. (-क्ष्मीः) Misfortune, poverty. E. अ priv. and लक्ष्मी fortune.
अलक्ष्य: अलक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Undistinguishable, undefinable. So अलक्षणीय.
अलगर्द: अलगर्द m. (-र्दः) 1 The black variety of the Cobra de Capello, (Coluber naga.) 2 A large black leech. E. अ neg. लग to be with or near, and क्विप् affix अलक; again अर्द to go, and अच् affix; not trailing its whole length upon the ground: also अलगर्द्ध.
अलग्न: अलग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Not joined or connected. E. अ neg. लग्न attached to.
अलघु: अलघु mfn. (-घुः-घुः-घ्वी-घु) 1 Heavy, weighty. 2 Serious, solemn. 3 Violent, intense. E. अ neg. लघु light.
अलघुप्रतिज्ञ: अलघुप्रतिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Solemnly pledged or promised. E. अलघु, and प्रतिज्ञा agreement.
अलघूपल: अलघूपल m. (-लः) A rock. E. अलघु, and उपल a stone.
अलघूष्मन्: अलघूष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) Intense heat. E. अलघु, and उष्मन् heat.
अलङ्करण: अलङ्करण n. (-णं) Ornament, decoration. E. अलम् ornament, and करण what makes.
अलङ्करिष्णु: अलङ्करिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Ornamented. 2 Fond of ornament. E. अलम् ornament, कर from कृ, and इष्णुच् aff.
अलङ्कर्तृ: अलङ्कर्तृ mfn. (-र्ता-र्त्री-र्तृ) Ornamented, ornamenting. E. अलम् as before, and कर्तृ who makes.
अलङ्कर्मीण: अलङ्कर्म्मीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Competent to an act, skilful, clever. E. अलम् able, fit for, कर्म्म act, business, ख aff.
अलङ्कर्म्मीण: अलङ्कर्म्मीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Competent to an act, skilful, clever. E. अलम् able, fit for, कर्म्म act, business, ख aff.
अलङ्कार: अलङ्कार m. (-रः) 1 Ornament (of dress), trinkets, jewels, &c. 2 (Of language,) A figure or rhetorical expression. 3 The art of composition. E. अलम् ornament, कार what makes.
अलङ्कारहीन: अलङ्कारहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unadorned. E. अलङ्कार, and हीन void of.
अलङ्क्रिया: अलङ्क्रिया f. (-या) Adorning, ornamenting. E. अलस्, and क्रिया act.
अलङ्कृत: अलङ्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ornamented, adorned, lit. or fig. E. अलम् as before, कृत made.
अलङ्घन: अलङ्घन n. (-नं) 1 Not transgressing. 2 Not passing over or beyond. E. अ neg. लङ्घन crossing.
अलङ्घनीय: अलङ्घनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Impassable, not to be crossed. 2 Venerable, inviolable, not to be transgressed. E. अ neg. लङ्घनीय to be passed, also अलङ्घ्यः.
अलङ्घनीयता: अलङ्घनीयता f. (-ता) 1 The state of not being passable. 2 Inviolability, respectability. E. तल् added to the last, also अलङ्घमीयत्वं.
अलङ्घ्य: अलङ्घ्य mfn. (-ङ्घ्यः-ङ्घ्या-ङ्घ्यं) 1 Inviolable. 2 Impassable. E. अ neg. लङ्घ्य to be crossed.
अलङ्घ्यता: अलङ्घ्यता f. (-ता) 1 Impassability, inaccessibility. 2 Superiority. 3 Authoritative or absolute rule. E. अलङ्घ्य not to be crossed or transgressed, तल् affix, also अलङ्घ्यत्वं.
अलज्ज: अलज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Shameless. E. अ neg. लज्जा shame. So अलज्जित.
अलजी: अलजी f. (-जी) Inflammation of the eye, at the edge of the cornea.
अलञ्जर: अलञ्जर m. (-रः) An earthen water jar. E. अलम् able, and जॄ to decay, also अलिञ्जर.
अलति: अलति m. (-तिः) A kind of song. E. अलम् ornament, and अति Uṇādi aff.
अलन्तराम्: अलन्तराम् ind. Quite enough, amply sufficient. E. अलं and तराम् aff.
अलब्ध: अलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Unobtained. E. अ and लब्ध attained.
अलन्धूम: अलन्धूम m. (-मः) A great smoke. E. अलम् much, and धूम smoke.
अलभ्य: अलभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Unattainable, unobtainable, E. अ neg. लभ्य to be got.
अलम्: अलम् ind. 1 Ornament. 2 Enough, abundance. 3 Able, adequate or equal to. 4 Prohibition, no, not. 5 Unnecessary, no need of. It is chiefly used in composition, as अलञ्जीविकः having enough for subsistence; अलन्दत्वा refusing to give; इत्यलम् enough; अलङ्कार ornament, &c. E. अल to adorn, &c. and अम् aff.
अलम्पुरुषीण: अलम्पुरुषीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Fit for a man, becoming a man. E. अलन्, पुरुष a man, and ख aff.
अलम्बुष: अलम्बुष m. (-षः) 1 The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. 2 Vomiting, sickness. 3 The name of a Rākṣasa or goblin. f. (-षा) 1 One of the Apsarasas or nymphs of Svarga. 2 Madder, (Rubia manjith.) 3 A sort of sensitive plant. 4 A barrier, a line or any thing not to be crossed. E. अलम्, and बुस to injure, affix क.
अलय: अलय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Houseless, homeless. E. अ neg. and लय place of refuge.
अलर्क: अलर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 White swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea alba.) 2 A mad dog or one rendered furious. 3 A fabulous animal, like a hog with eight legs. 4 An Asura changed to such an animal. Also अलर्क्क. E. अल to adorn, &c. क्विप् affix, and अर्क to inflame or heat.
अलले: अलले ind. A word of no import, occurring in the dialect or gibberish of Piśācas, a class of imps or goblins, when they are introduced in plays, &c.
अलवाल: अलवाल n. (-लं) A basin for water at the root of a tree. E. अ neg. लू to cut, and आल affix; also आलवाल.
अलवालक: अलवालक n. (-कं) See the preceding. E. as before, कन् added.
अलस: अलस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Lazy, idle, indolent. m. (-सः) 1 Swelling of the feet in elephantiasis. 2 Chaps between the toes. 3 Name  of a tree. f. (-सा) A creeping plant, (Cissus pedata.) E. अ neg. and लस to work, affix अच्.
अलसक: अलसक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Indolent. m. (-कः) Flatulence, Tympanitis, intumescence of the abdomen, with constipation and wind. E. कन् added to the last.
अलसता: अलसता f. (-ता) Idleness. E. अलस and तल् aff.
अलसत्व: अलसत्व n. (-त्वं) Idleness. E. अलस and त्वं aff.
अलसेक्षणा: अलसेक्षणा f. (-णा) A woman with languishing looks. E. अलस idle, and ईक्षणा looking.
अलात: अलात n. (-तं) A fire brand, whether burning or extinguished. E. अ neg. ला to take, and क्त aff.
अलाबु: अलाबु f. (-बुः) A long gourd. See the next word.
अलाबू: अलाबू f. (-बूः) The bottle gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaris.) E. अ neg. लब to sink, ऊ Uṇādi affix; म् is dropped, and the preceding vowel lengthened: what does not sink in water; floats, &c. are made of this gourd, especially when hollowed: also अलाबु and आलाबु.
अलाबूकट: अलाबूकट n. (-टं) The down of the gourd. E. अलाबू and कटच् aff.
अलाभ: अलाभ m. (-भः) 1 Non-acquirement, not getting. 2 Loss. E. अ neg. लाभ gain.
अलार: अलार m. (-रः) A door. E. अल able, and ऋ to go, अच् affix; by which one may go.
अलास: अलास m. (-सः) Inflammation and abscess at the root of the tongue. E. अ neg. लास saliva.
अलि: अलि m. (-लिः) 1 A large black bee. 2 A scorpion. 3 The sign Scorpio. 4 A crow. 5 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 6 Spirituous liquor. E. अल to be able, &c. and इण Uṇādi aff.
अलिक: अलिक n. (-कं) The forehead. E. अल to adorn, &c. and इकन् affix; also अलीक.
अलिकुल: अलिकुल n. (-लं) A flight or a number of bees. E. अलि, and कुल a number.
अलिगर्द्ध: अलिगर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A snake, the black Cobra. E. अलि, and गर्द्ध to sound, affix अच्; hissing like the scorpion.
अलिङ्गिन्: अलिङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) An impostor, a pretended ascetic or student, one wearing the usual marks, as the frontal marks, skin, staff, &c. without belonging in reality to a religious order. E. अ neg. लिङ्ग sectarial mark, इनि aff.
अलिजिह्वा: अलिजिह्वा f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate. Also अलिजिह्विका.
अलिञ्जर: अलिञ्जर m. (-रः) An earthen water jar. E. अलिम् strength, acc. of अलि and जॄ to waste, अच् aff.
अलिन्: अलिन् m. (-ली) 1 A large black bee. 2 A scorpion. E. अल a sting, and इनि aff.
अलिन्द: अलिन्द m. (-न्दः) A terrace before a house. E. अल to adorn, &c. and किन्दच् affix; also आलिन्द.
अलिपक: अलिपक m. (कः) 1 A large black bee. 2 A scorpion. 3 A dog. Also read अलिम्पक and अलिमक.
अलिपिज्ञ: अलिपिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Ignorant of reading and writing. E. अ neg. लिपि writing, ज्ञ who knows.
अलिप्रिय: अलिप्रिय n. (-यं) The red lotus, (Nymphoea rubra.) f. (-या) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. अलि a bee, and प्रिय beloved, the object of the bee's affections: the lotus especially is so described by the poets.
अलिप्सा: अलिप्सा f. (-प्सा) Freedom from desire or cupidity. E. अ neg. and लिप्सा wish.
अलिमक: अलिमक m. (-कः) 1 A frog. 2 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 3 A large black bee. 4 The filaments of the lotus. 5 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) E. अलि from अल to adorn, मकच् affix; also अलिपक.
अलिमाला: अलिमाला f. (-ला) A flight of bees. E. अलि, and माला a necklace.
अलिम्पक: अलिम्पक m. (-कः) 1 A bee. 2 The Kokila. 3 A dog. 4 The filaments of the lotus. E. अ neg. लिपि to smear, वुन् affix; also read अलिवकः and अलिम्बकः.
अलिविराव: अलिविराव m. (-वः) The hum of bees. E. अलि, and विराव sound.
अलिविरुत: अलिविरुत n. (-तं) The song or hum of the bee. E. अलि, and विरुत sound.
अलीक: अलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 False. 2 Unpleasing. 3 Small, little. n. (-कं) 1 Falsehood, untruth. 2 Any thing displeasing. 3 Heaven. 4 The forehead. E. अल to adorn, &c. and कीकच Uṇādi aff.
अलीकता: अलीकता f. (-ता) Falsehood, vanity: also अलीकत्व. E. तल् or त्व added to the last.
अलीकमत्स्य: अलीकमत्स्य m. (-त्स्यः) A cake of beans fried with Sesamum oil. E. अलीक unreal, मत्स्य fish.
अलु: अलु f. (-लुः) A small water pot. E. ऋ to go, and उच् affix, र becomes ल; also आलु.
अलुब्ध: अलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Moderate, content, not covetous. E. अ, and लुब्ध covetous.
अलून: अलून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Uncut, unshorn. E. अ neg. लून cut.
अले: अले ind. An unmeaning word in the dialect of the demons or Piśācas, when they are introduced in plays, &c. also अलले.
अलेले: अलेले ind. See the preceding word.
अलेश: अलेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Much, large. adv. n. (-शं) Not at all. E. अ neg. लेश small.
अलेशैज: अलेशैज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Firm, steady. E. अलेश not at all, एज what shakes.
अलोकन: अलोकन n. (-नं) Disappearance, invisibility. E. अ neg. लोकन seeing.
अलोकनीय: अलोकनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Invisible, imperceptible. E. अ neg. लोकनीय visible.
अलोकित: अलोकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unseen. E. अ neg. लोकित seen.
अलोभ: अलोभ m. (-भः) Moderation, content, absence of cupidity. E. अ, and लोभ desire.
अलोभिन्: अलोभिन् mfn. (-भी-भिनी-भि) Not wanting or desiring any thing, free from desire. E. अ, and लोभिन् desirous.
अलोल: अलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Firm, steady, tranquil, unagitated. E. अ neg. लोल moving.
अलोलु: अलोलु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Indifferent to sensual objects. E. अ neg. लोल to desire, affix उ.
अलोलुप: अलोलुप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Free from desire. E. अ neg. लोलुप libidinous.
अलोलुत्व: अलोलुत्व n. (-त्वं) Indifference to sensual objects. E. अलोलु and त्व affix: also अलोलुता.
अलौकिक: अलौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Supernatural, not relating, to this world. 2 Not common, not current in the world. 3 Indifferent to the world, unworldly. E. अ neg. लौकिक mundane.
अल्क: अल्क m. (-ल्कं) 1 A tree. 2 A member of the body.
अल्प: अल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) 1 Little, small. 2 Inferior, low. E. अल to be able, &c. प affix or with कन् added अल्पक.
अल्पक: अल्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Small, minute. E. अल्प and कन् added.
अल्पकेशी: अल्पकेशी f. (-शी) The root of sweet flag. E. अल्प small, and केशी having filaments, &c.
अल्पगन्ध: अल्पगन्ध n. (न्धं) The red lotus. E. अल्प, and गन्ध smell.
अल्पज्ञ: अल्पज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Ignorant, shallow, superficial. E. अल्प and ज्ञ who knows.
अल्पतनु: अल्पतनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Small, short, thing, pigmy, having a little body. E. अल्प, and तनु the body.
अल्पता: अल्पता f. (-ता) 1 Smallness, minuteness. 2 Inferiority, insignificance. E. अल्प and तल् affix, or with त्व, अल्पत्वं.
अल्पदक्षिण: अल्पदक्षिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Defective in presents, (any ceremony, &c.) E. अल्प, and दक्षिणा gift to Brahmans.
अल्पधन: अल्पधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of little wealth, not affluent. E. अल्प, and घन wealth.
अल्पधी: अल्पधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Ignorant, foolish, of little sense. E. अल्प, and धी understanding.
अल्पपत्र: अल्पपत्र m. (-त्रः) A species of the Tulasi. E. अल्प, and पत्र a leaf.
अल्पपद्म: अल्पपद्म n. (-द्मं) The red lotus. E. अल्प small, and पद्म lotus.
अल्पप्रभाव: अल्पप्रभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Insignificant, of little weight or consequence. E. अल्प, and प्रभाव authority.
अल्पप्रमाण: अल्पप्रमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Of little authority. 2 Of little weight or measure. E. अल्प and प्रमाण authority, &c.
अल्पप्रमाणक: अल्पप्रमाणक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Credulous, resting on little evidence. 2 Of little weight or authority. 3 Of short measure. m. (-कः) Common cucumber, (Cucumis sativus.) E. अल्प, and प्रमाण authority, &c. कन् added.
अल्पबल: अल्पबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Feeble, of little strength. E. अल्प, and वल strength.
अल्पबाध: अल्पबाध m. (-धः-धा-धं) Causing little annoyance or inconvenience. E. अल्प, and बाधा pain.
अल्पबुद्धि: अल्पबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Ignorant, silly, unwise. E. अल्प, बुद्धि understanding.
अल्पमात्र: अल्पमात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A little, a little only. 2 A short time, a few moments. E. अल्प, and मात्र only.
अल्पमारिष: अल्पमारिष m. (-षः) A kind of amaranth, (Amaranthus polygamus.) E. अल्प, मृष to hurt, and इमच् aff.
अल्पमूर्ति: अल्पमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Small, diminutive. f. (-र्त्तिः) A small figure or object. E. अल्प, and मूर्त्ति form.
अल्पमूर्त्ति: अल्पमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Small, diminutive. f. (-र्त्तिः) A small figure or object. E. अल्प, and मूर्त्ति form.
अल्पमेधस्: अल्पमेधस् mfn. (-धाः-धाः-धः) Ignorant, silly, of little understanding. E. अल्प, and मेधस् apprehension.
अल्पवयस्: अल्पवयस् mfn. (-याः-याः-यः) Young, of few years. E. अल्प, and वयस् life.
अल्पवादिन्: अल्पवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Taciturn: also अल्पभाषिन्. E. अल्प and वादिन् or भाषिन् who speaks.
अल्पविषय: अल्पविषय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Meaning or directing a little. E. अल्प, and विषय object.
अल्पविद्य: अल्पविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Ill taught, uneducated, ignorant. E. अल्प and विद्या knowledge.
अल्पशक्ति: अल्पशक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Weak, feeble. E. अल्प, and शक्ति power.
अल्पशस: अल्पशस ind. 1 A little. 2 To a few. E. अल्प and शसि aff.
अल्पसरस्: अल्पसरस् n. (-रः) A basin, a small pond, one which is shallow or dry in the hot season. E. अल्प, and सरस् a pool.
अल्पाकाङ्क्षिन्: अल्पाकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Contented, satisfied with little. E. अल्प, and आकाङ्क्षिन् who desires.
अल्पायुस्: अल्पायुस् mfn. (-युः-युः-युः) 1 Short lived. 2 Young, of few years. m. (-युः) A goat. E. अल्प, and आयस् life.
अल्पाल्प: अल्पाल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) 1 Very little, minute. 2 Grandual, little at a time. E. अल्प repeated.
अल्पाहार: अल्पाहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Moderate, abstemious. m. (-रः) Moderation, abstinence. E. अल्प, and आहार food.
अल्पाहारिन्: अल्पाहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Abstemious, moderate. E. अल्प, and आहारिन् who feeds.
अल्पिष्ठ: अल्पिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Least, smallest, very small. E. अल्प, and इष्ठच् affix of the superlative.
अल्पीकृत: अल्पीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reduced, comminuted, made little or few. E. अल्प and कृत with च्चि inserted.
अल्पीभूत: अल्पीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reduced, diminished, become little or few. E. अल्प, and भूत become, च्चि inserted.
अल्पीयस्: अल्पीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very small. E. अल्प and ईयसुन् affix. Also अल्पिष्ठ.
अल्पोन: अल्पोन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Defective, not quite finished, not wholly entire. E. अल्प a little, ऊन less.
अल्ला: अल्ला f. (-ल्ला) A mother, in dramatic language.
अव: अव r. 1st cl. (अवति) 1 To keep, protect or defend. 2 To please. (The following meanings, although found in lists of roots, are rarely used:) 3 To move. 4 To excite affection or be lovely. 5 To satisfy. 6 To know or apprehend. 7 To enter. 8 To be near. 9 To own, to have a right. 10 To obey. 11 To act. 12 To desire. 13 To shine or be splendid. 14 To obtain. 15 To embrace. 16 To kill or hurt. 17 To take. 18 To be. 19 To grow. In place of 9, 17, and 18 as above, some read; 9 To be able. 17 To burn, and 18 To divide or share.

अव ind. A preposition and prefix to words, corresponding to off, from, down from, out, away, &c. and implying; 1 Diminution. 2 Depreciation. 3 Diffusion. 4 Support, resting. 5 Commanding. 6 Purifying, correcting. 7 Knowledge. 8 Disrespect. 9 Nourishing. As अवगन्तुं To go away; अवज्ञातुं To disrespect; अवतरितुं To come down, to descend; अवस्थातुं To remain in or on; अवहर्त्तुं To take off or away; also अवमः a low man; अवाक् reverse, behind; अवकोकिलः a koïl with a bad voice, &c.
अवकट: अवकट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Opposite, contrary. 2 Backwards. 3 Downwards. n. (-टं) Opposition, contrariety, reverse. E. अव down, and कठच् aff.
अवकम्पित: अवकम्पित m. A Buddha. E. अव, and कम्पित shaken.
अवकर: अवकर m. (-रः) Dust or sweepings. E. अव spreading, and कर what makes.
अवकर्तन: अवकर्त्तन n. (-नं) Excision, cutting off. E. अव and कर्त्तन cutting.
अवकर्त्तन: अवकर्त्तन n. (-नं) Excision, cutting off. E. अव and कर्त्तन cutting.
अवकर्षण: अवकर्षण n. (-र्णं) 1 Taking or pulling out, extraction, expulsion. 2 Pulling, dragging. E. अव, and कर्षण pulling.
अवकलित: अवकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen. E. अव and कलित part. past of कल to sound, &c.
अवकाश: अवकाश m. (-शः) 1 Leisure, opportunity. 2 Interval, space. 3 An open or wide space. 4 A receptacle, a repository, a place in which any thing is kept. 5 A place, a spot, a situation. E. अव between, &c. काश to shine, अच् aff.
अवकीर्ण: अवकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Coarsely pounded. 2 Scattered. 3 Disregarded, violated. E. अव implying separation, कॄ to scatter in the irregular part. past.
अवकीर्णिन्: अवकीर्णिन् mfn. (-र्णी-र्णिनी-र्णि) Violating a vow or engagement to be chaste, abstemious, &c. m. (-र्णी) The religious student who has committed an act of incontinency. E. अव before, कॄ to scatter, क्त the part. past, and इनि aff.
अवकीर्णिव्रत: अवकीर्णिव्रत n. (-तं) Penance for an act of incontinency. E. अवकीर्णिन् and व्रत religious obligation.
अवकुञ्चन: अवकुञ्चन n. (-नं) Bending, curving, flexure, contraction. E. अव and कुञ्चन curving.
अवकुटार: अवकुटार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Opposite, contrary. 2 Backwards. 3 Downwards. n. (-रं) Reverse, contrariety. E. अव and कुटार aff.
अवकुट्टित: अवकुट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Vexed. 2 Inflamed. 3 Cut off. E. अव, and कुट्ट to heat, &c. क्त aff.
अवकुण्ठन: अवकुण्ठन n. (-नं) 1 Investing, surrounding. 2 Attracting. E. अव, before कुठ to surround, ल्युट् aff.
अवकुण्ठित: अवकुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Affected. 2 Surrounded, attracted. E. अव before कुठ to surround, क्त aff.
अवकृष्ट: अवकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Expelled, turned out. 2 Removed, sent away, drawn aside. 3 Extracted. 4 Pulled. 5 Inferior, low. 6 Degraded, outcaste. m. (-ष्टः) A servant who performs the lowest office, a sweeper, a waterman, &c. E. अव out of, and कृष्ट drawn.
अवकृष्य: अवकृष्य ind. 1 Having drawn out or extracted. 2 Having drawn together or contracted. E. अव, and कृष to draw, यत् aff.
अवकेशिन्: अवकेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Barren. E. अव privative, केश properly hair, in this instance fruit, and इनि aff.
अवक्तव्य: अवक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Not to be said, improper. 2 Indescribable. E. अ neg. वक्तव्य to be said.
अवक्र: अवक्र mfn. (-क्रः-क्रा-क्रं) 1 Straight. 2 Upright, honest. E. अ neg. वक्र crooked liter. and metaph.
अवक्रन्दन: अवक्रन्दन n. (-नं) Weeping aloud. E. अव, and क्रन्दन crying.
अवक्रय: अवक्रय m. (-यः) Price. E. अव, and क्री to buy, अच् aff.
अवक्रान्ति: अवक्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Descent, descending. 2 Approaching, going near to. E. अव, and क्रान्ति passing.
अवक्रिया: अवक्रिया f. (-या) Neglect, omission, non-performance of prescribed acts. E. अव priv. क्रिया act.
अवक्रुष्ट: अवक्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sounded ill or badly. 2 Reviled, abused. E. अव, and क्रुष्ट sounded.
अवक्रोश: अवक्रोश m. (-शः) 1 A disagreeable noise. 2 A curse, an imprecation. 3 Abuse. E. अव and क्रुश to sound, घञ् aff.
अवक्लेद: अवक्लेद m. (-दः) 1 Ichor, malignant or fetid discharge. 2 Trickling, descent of moisture. E. अव, and क्लेद what wets.
अवक्लेदन: अवक्लेदन n. (-नं) Trickling, falling as dew or moisture. E. अव and क्लेदन wetting.
अवक्वण: अवक्वण m. (-णः) A discord, a false note. E. अव, and क्वण a sound.
अवक्वाथ: अवक्वाथ m. (-थः) Imperfect digestion or decoction. E. अव and क्वाथ a decoction.
अवक्षय: अवक्षय m. (-यः) Loss, waste, destruction. E. अव, and क्षय waste.
अवक्षिप्त: अवक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Said sarcastically, imputed, insinuated. 2 Ill thrown. 3 Thrown down. E. अव, and क्षिप्त thrown.
अवक्षीण: अवक्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Emaciated, wasted. E. अव, and क्षीण wasted.
अवक्षुत: अवक्षुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sneezed upon. E. अव, and क्षुत sneezed.
अवक्षेप: अवक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Sarcasm, irony. 3 Throwing wrong or improperly. 3 Throwing down. E. अव, and क्षेप throwing.
अवगणित: अवगणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disregarded, despised. E. अव, गण to count or reckon in the past. part.
अवगण्ड: अवगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A boil or pimple upon the face. E. अव, गडि to affect the cheek, अच् aff.
अवगत: अवगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood. 2 Gone, gone off or away. 3 Assented, promised. E. अव implying knowledge, and गत part. past of गम to go.
अवगति: अवगति f. (-तिः) 1 Knowledge in general. 2 Departure, removal. E. अव, गम to go, and क्तिन् aff.
अवगथ: अवगथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Bathing or bathed early in the morning. E. अव, ग from गम to go, and थक् aff.
अवगदित: अवगदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unsaid, unuttered. E. अव reverse, गदित said.
अवगन्तव्य: अवगन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Meant, intended to be known or understood. 2 To be quitted. So अवगम्य. E. अव and गन्तव्य to be gone.
अवगम: अवगम m. (-मः) 1 Knowledge, certainty. 2 Removal, departure. E. अव, and गम going.
अवगाढ: अवगाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Immersed, plunged, bathed. 2 Deep. E. अवगाह and क्त aff.
अवगाढवत्: अवगाढवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Bathing, plunging, diving. E. अवगाढ and वतुप् aff.
अवगाद: अवगाद m. (-दः) A small wooden bason for baling water out of a boat. E. अव for अप water, ग from गम to go, and आदक् aff.
अवगाह: अवगाह m. (-हः) 1 Bathing. 2 Bathing place, bath. E. अब before, गाह to agitate: also वगाह.
अवगाहन: अवगाहन n. (-नं) Bathing. E. अवगाह and ल्युट् aff.
अवगाहित: अवगाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bathed, immersed. E. अवगाह, and क्त affix, with इट् augment.
अवगीत: अवगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reproached, abused, censured. 2 Wicked, vile. 3 Sung depreciatingly, satirised in song. 4 Sung badly. n. (-तं) 1 Reproach, blame. 2 Satire in song. 3 Bad singing. E. अव bad, &c. गीत sounded, sung.
अवगुण्ठन: अवगुण्ठन n. (-नं) 1 A veil. 2 Sweeping. 3 Hiding, veiling. E. गुठि to enclose, with अव prefixed, and ल्युट् aff.
अवगुण्ठिका: अवगुण्ठिका f. (-का) See the preceding. E. as before, with वुन् and टाप् aff.
अवगुण्ठित: अवगुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Concealed, covered, veiled, screened. E. अवगुठ to enclose, क्त aff.
अवगुण्डित: अवगुण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pounded, ground, pulverulent. E. अव prefixed to गुण्डित pounded.
अवगोरण: अवगोरण n. (-णं) Assailing with weapons, assaulting with intent to kill. E. अव, गुर् or गूर् to assault, ल्युट् aff.
अवग्रह: अवग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Taking, acceptance. 2 Taking off or away, seizure. 3 Disrespect. 4 Drought. 5 Obstacle, impediment. 6 An elephant's forehead. 7 A herd of elephants. 8 Nature, original temperament. 9 A sort of knowledge, a false idea. 10 An imprecation or term of abuse. E. अव before, ग्रह to take or seize, अप् affix: also अवग्राह.
अवग्रहण: अवग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Obstacle, impediment. 2 Disrespect. E. अव, ग्रह to take, and ल्युट् aff.
अवग्राह: अवग्राह m. (-हः) 1 An imprecation or term of abuse, as अवग्राहस्ते स्यात्, may disappointment befall you. 2 Drought. 3 Disgrace, discomfiture: see अवग्रह. E. as before, and घञ् aff.
अवगृह्य: अवगृह्य n. (-ह्यं) An inflection, an inflective termination. E. अव before ग्रह to take, क्यप् aff.
अवघट्ट: अवघट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A hole in the ground, a cave, a cavern. E. अव down, low, घट्ट to move, अच् aff.
अवघर्षण: अवघर्षण n. (-णं) Rubbing, scrubbing. E. अव, and घर्षण rubbing.
अवघर्षित: अवघर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rubbed, scrubbed. E. अव, and घर्षित rubbed.
अवघात: अवघात m. (-तः) 1 Threshing corn, by bruising it with a wooden pestle in a mortar of the same material. 2 Sudden or violent death. 3 Strinking, killing. 4 A violent or fatal blow. E. अव, and घात struck.
अवघातिन्: अवघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Striking, killing. E. अव before हन to strike, णिनि aff.
अवघुष्ट: अवघुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Proclaimed, denounced. E. अव, and घुष्ट cried.
अवघूर्ण: अवघूर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A whirling round. 2 A whirlpool. E. अव before घूर्ण to roll round, अच् aff.
अवघूर्णन: अवघूर्णन n. (-नं) Rolling or whirling round. E. अव, and घूर्णन rolling.
अवघूर्णित: अवघूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Whirled round. E. अव, and घूर्णित whirled.
अवघोषण: अवघोषण n. (-णं) Crying, proclaiming, denouncing. E. अव, and घोषण proclamation.
अवचन: अवचन n. (-नं) Silence, not speaking. E. अ neg. वचन word.
अवचनीय: अवचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be spoken, improper. E. अ neg. वचनीय to be said.
अवचनीयता: अवचनीयता f. (-ता) Impropriety of speech. E. अवचनीय and तल् affix; also अवचनीयत्वं.
अवचय: अवचय m. (-यः) Gathering, especially flowers, fruits, &c. E. अव, and चय collecting; also अवचाय.
अवचस्कर: अवचस्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Silent, not speaking. E. अ neg. वच speech, कर who makes.
अवचार्य: अवचार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be cast down. 2 To be given. 3 To be put on or applied. E. अव, चर to go, causal form, यत् aff.
अवचार्य्य: अवचार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be cast down. 2 To be given. 3 To be put on or applied. E. अव, चर to go, causal form, यत् aff.
अवचूड: अवचूड m. (-डः) The crest or ornamented top of a standard, hanging downwards. E. अव, चूडा a crest; also अवचूडक and अवचूल.
अवचूर्णन: अवचूर्णन n. (-नं) 1 Pounding, grinding, reducing to powder. 2 Sprinkling absorbent powders on sores. E. अव, चूर्ण to pound, ल्युट् aff.
अवचूर्णित: अवचूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Coarsely pounded. E. अव, चूर्ण to pound, in the part. past.
अवचूल: अवचूल m. (-लः) 1 The ornamented head of a standard, when the ornaments, streamers, peacockś tails, &c. hang downward. 2 A chowri. E. अव inferior, and चूडा crest, ड changed to ल.
अवचूलक: अवचूलक n. (-कं) A chowri or brush formed of a cow's tail, peacock's feathers, &c. for fanning off lies. E. कन् affixed to the preceding.
अवच्छात: अवच्छात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Emaciated by abstinence. 2 Reaped. 3 Cut off. E. अव before छो to destroy, क्त aff.
अवच्छिन्न: अवच्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Cut off. 2 Divided, separated, detached. 3 In logic, predicated. i. e. separated from every thing else by the properties especially predicated of any thing. 4 Bounded. E. अव affix, छिन्न cut.
अवच्छुरित: अवच्छुरित n. (-तं) A horse laugh. E. अव, छुर to cut or split, and the affix of the part. past: what splits, (one's sides.)
अवच्छुरितक: अवच्छुरितक n. (-कं) A horse laugh. E. see the preceding word, कन् being added.
अवच्छेद: अवच्छेद m. (-दः) 1 A predicate, the property of a thing by which it is distinguished from every other. 3 A part, a portion. 3 A boundary, a barrier. 4 Amputation, excision. E. अव off, छेद cutting.
अवच्छेदक: अवच्छेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Peculiar, distinguishing, that which separates. 2 Bounding, separating one thing from another. m. (-कः) 1 A predicate, a property. 2 A barrier, a boundary. E. कन् added to the last.
अवच्छेदन: अवच्छेदन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting off. 2 Separating, dividing. 3 Discriminating, distinguishing. E. अव, and छेदन cutting.
अवच्छेदावच्छेद: अवच्छेदावच्छेद m. (-दः) Generalising, removing distinctions. E. अवछेद a distinction, and cutting off.
अवजनित: अवजनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Born. E. अव, and जनित born.
अवजय: अवजय m. (-यः) Overcoming, victory. E. अव, and जय conquer.
अवजित: अवजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Conquered. 2 Contemned, disregarded. E. अव, and जित conquered.
अवज्ञा: अवज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Disrespect. E. अव, ज्ञा to know, अङ् affix, and टाप for the fem.; also अवज्ञता.
अवज्ञात: अवज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disrespected. E. अव, ज्ञात part. past, of ज्ञा to know.
अवज्ञान: अवज्ञान n. (-नं) Disrepect. E. अव before ज्ञान knowledge.
अवज्ञेय: अवज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Contemptible, disreputable, to be treated with disrespect: so अवज्ञातव्य. E. अव, and ज्ञा to know, यत् aff.
अवज्ञोपहत: अवज्ञोपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Degraded, humiliated. E. अवज्ञा, and उपहत wounded.
अवट: अवट m. (-टः) 1 A hole, a vacuity. 2 A hole in the ground, a chasm, a pit. 3 Any depressed part of the body, a cavity, a fosse, a sinus. 4 A well. 5 A juggler. E. अव to preserve, अटन् aff.
अवटङ्क: अवटङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A mart; also अवटङ्ग.
अवटि: अवटि m. (-टिः) 1 A hole in the ground. 2 In anatomy, a sinus. a hollow, a cavity. E. as before, अटिन् aff.
अवटीट: अवटीट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Flat-nosed. E. अव implying lowness, flatness, and टीटच् aff.
अवटु: अवटु f. (-टः) 1 The back of the neck. 2 A hole in the ground. 2 A well. 4 The name of a tree. E. अव down, and टीक to go, irregular affix डु; or अ neg. वट to surround, and उ aff.
अवटुज: अवटुज m. (-जः) A hind curl, the hair on the back of the head. E. अवटु, and ज born.
अवडीन: अवडीन n. (-नं) The flight of a bird, or a particular act of such flight; flying down. E. अव down, &c. and डीन flying: see प्रडीन, उड्डीन, &c.
अवतंस: अवतंस mn. (-सः-सं) 1 An ear-ring. 2 A crest. E. अव, तसि a Sautra root to adorn, अच्, aff.
अवतंसित: अवतंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Having an ear-ring. 2 Crested. E. अवतंस and इतच् aff.
अवतति: अवतति f. (-तिः) Stretching, extending. E. अव, and तन to spread, क्तिन् aff.
अवतमस: अवतमस n. (-सं) Slight darkness, obscurity. E. अव implying deficiency, and तमस् darkness, अच् aff.
अवतरण: अवतरण n. (-णं) 1 Descending, alighting. 2 Crossing. 3 Translating. 4 Quoting, citing. E. अव down, तॄ to cross, ल्युट् aff.
अवतान: अवतान m. (-नः) Stretching, extension. E. अव before तन to stretch, affix ण.
अवतार: अवतार n. (-रं) 1 Descent, especially of a deity from heaven; the appearance of any deity upon earth, but more particularly the incarnations of VIṢṆU in ten principal forms which are well known, viz. 1 The fish. 2 The tortoise. 3 The boar. 4 The man-lion. 5 The dwarf. 6 and 7 The two RĀMAS. 8 KṚṢṆA. 9 BUDDHA. And 10 KALKI. A pious or distinguished person, in the language of respect or flattery, is also called an Avatāra, a descent or incarnation of the deity. 2 A Tīrtha or sacred place. 3 Translation, translating. 3 Descent. 4 Crossing. E. अव before, तॄ to cross, affix घञ्.
अवतारण: अवतारण n. (-णं) 1 Possession by an evil spirit. 2 The ends or border of a garment. 3 Worship, adoration. 4 Taking out. E. अव, तॄ to pass, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
अवतारित: अवतारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken off or out, laid down or aside. 2 Descended. E. अव and तॄ causal form, क्त aff.
अवतीर्ण: अवतीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Descended, alighted. 2 Crossed, passed over. 3 Translated. E. अव and तॄ with क्त aff.
अवतोका: अवतोका f. (-का) A cow miscarrying from accident. E. अव, implying censure, and तोक offspring.
अवदंश: अवदंश m. (-शः) A relish, or what excites thirst. E. अव, दंश to bite, to be pungent, अच् aff.
अवदत्त: अवदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Given away. 2 Finished, accomplished. E. अव before दा to give, क्त aff.
अवदात: अवदात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 White. 2 Yellow. 3 Clean, clear. 4 Beautiful. m. (-तः) White, (the colour.) E. अव, दै to cleanse, क्त affix of the part. past.
अवदातक: अवदातक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) As above. m. (-कः) White. E. कन् added to the last.
अवदान: अवदान n. (-नं) 1 Approved occupation. 2 An act accomplished. 3 Achievement, a great or glorious act. 4 Breaking, dividing. 5 The root of a fragrant grass; see अवदाह. 6 An oblation. E. अव, दै to cleanse, to purify, or दा to give, and ल्यट् aff.
अवदारण: अवदारण n. (-णं) 1 A spade or hoe. 2 Tearing, dividing. E. अव down, दॄ to tear or rend, ल्युट् aff.
अवदारित: अवदारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Torn, rent. E. अव before दॄ to tear, क्त aff.
अवदाह: अवदाह n. (-हं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum). E. अब reverse, and दाह heat, burning, heat-preventing, from its being used in Tātis or screens, placed before doors, &c. and kept constantly wet: the air passing through these, blows into a room cool and refreshing.
अवदाहेष्टकापथ: अवदाहेष्टकापथ n. (-थ) See अवदाह. See also इष्टकापथ.
अवदीर्ण: अवदीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Melted, fused, liquefied. 2 Torn, rent, sundered. E. अव, दॄ to separate, irregular part. past.
अवदून: अवदून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Regretted. E. अव, दु to be sorry, affix क्त.
अवदोह: अवदोह m. (-हः) Milk. E. अव, दुह to milk, घञ् aff.
अवद्य: अवद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Low, inferior. 2 Disagreeable, disliked. n. (-द्यं) Sin, vice. E. अ neg. वद to speak, and यत् affix of the part. future; not to be spoken.
अवद्रङ्क: अवद्रङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A market or fair.
अवधातव्य: अवधातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be attended to, deserving attention and care. So अबधानीय and अवधेय. E. अव before धा to have, तव्य, अनीयर or यत् aff.
अवधान: अवधान n. (-नं) 1 Attention, attentiveness, intentness. 2 Care, carefulness. E. अव, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.
अवधानता: अवधानता f. (-ता) Attentiveness. E. अवधान attention, तल् added, also with त्व, अवधानत्व n. (-त्वं.)
अवधारण: अवधारण n. (-णं) 1 Determining, certainty, ascertainment. 2 Emphasis. E. अव before धृ to hold, ल्युट् aff.
अवधारणीय: अवधारणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be ascertained. E. अव before धृ to hold, causal form, अनीयर aff.
अवधारित: अवधारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Certain, known, ascertained. E. अव before धृ to hold, causal form, क्त aff.
अवधार्य: अवधार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be ascertained or known. E. अव before धृ to hold, causal form, यत् aff.
अवधार्य्य: अवधार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be ascertained or known. E. अव before धृ to hold, causal form, यत् aff.
अवधावन: अवधावन n. (-नं) 1 Running after, pursuing. 2 Taking, seizure. 3 Cleaning. E. अव, धाव to run, affix ल्युट्.
अवधावनीय: अवधावनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be run after. 2 To be seized. E. अव after, धाव to run, अनीयर aff.
अवधावित: अवधावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Chased, pursued. 2 Cleaned. E. अव before धाव to run, affix क्त.
अवधि: अवधि m. (-धिः) 1 Limit, division. 2 Period, time. 3 A hole, a pit. 4 Agreement, engagement. 5 Conclusion, termination. 6 Attention, application. 7 Care. E. अव, धा to have, कि aff.
अवधिता: अवधिता f. (-ता) Limit, limitation. E. अवधि with तल् affix; also with त्व, अवधित्वं.
अवधीर: अवधीर r. 10th cl. (अवधीरयति) To disregard, to disrespect.
अवधीरण: अवधीरण n. (-णं) Treating with disrespect. E. अवधीर and ल्युट aff.
अवधीरित: अवधीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disrespected, disregarded. E. अवधीर and क्त aff.
अवधूत: अवधूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Compelled. 2 Discarded. 3 Shaken, removed, tossed. 4 Trodden upon. 5 Separated from worldly feeling and obligation. E. अव, and धूत shaken.
अवधूनन: अवधूनन n. (-नं) 1 Shaking, causing to shake. 2 Expelling. 3 Being in agitation, trembling. 4 Trampling on, treading on E. अव before धूनन shaking.
अवध्वंस: अवध्वंस m. (-सः) 1 Censure, blame. 2 Abandoning, quitting. 3 Pounding, grinding. E. अव before ध्वंस to go, घञ् aff.
अवध्वस्त: अवध्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Pounded coarsely. 2 Abandoned. 3 Censured. E. अव separate, &c. ध्वस to go, part. affix क्त.
अवन: अवन n. (-नं) 1 Satisfaction, (given or received.) 2 Preserving, protecting. 3 Kindness. 4 Speed. 5 Going. 6 Obtaining. 7 Asking. 8 Seizing. 9 Killing. 10 Strength, power. 11 Increase. 12 Existence, being. 13 Doing. 14 Desire. 15 Beautifying, adorning. 16 Embracing. 17 Bearing. 18 Entrance. E. अव to go, to preserve, &c. ल्युट् aff.
अवनत: अवनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bending, stooping, bowed. E. अव down, नम to bow, क्त aff.
अवनति: अवनति f. (-तिः) 1 Bowing, stooping. 2 Setting. E. अव, and नति bowing.
अवनद्ध: अवनद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound on, tied, fastened. n. (-द्वः) A drum: see आनद्ध. E. अव, and नद्ध bound.
अवनय: अवनय m. (-यः) Causing to descend, throwing down. E. अव down, नय for नाय causing to get: see अवनाय.
अवनाट: अवनाट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Flat-nosed. E. अव flatness, नाटच् affix, in this sense.
अवनाम: अवनाम m. (-मः) Causing to bend, bending, bowing. E. अव before नम to bow, घञ् aff.
अवनामक: अवनामक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What depresses or causes to bow or bend. E. अव and नम in the causal, वुन् aff.
अवनामिन्: अवनामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Bending or bowing down. E. अव, and नामिन् what bends.
अवनाय: अवनाय m. (-यः) Causing to descend, throwing down, precipitating. E. अव down, णीञ् to obtain, in the causal form, घञ् aff.
अवनायक: अवनायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Causing to descend. E. अव before नी to obtain, causal form, वुन् aff.
अवनाह: अवनाह m. (-हः) Binding, girding, putting on. E. अव before नह to bind, घञ् aff.
अवनि: अवनि f. (-निः) The earth. E. अव to preserve, अनि Uṇādi affix; it is also written अवनी.
अवनिपति: अवनिपति m. (-तिः) 1 A king. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. अवनि, and पति lord.
अवनिपाल: अवनिपाल m. (-लः) A king. E. अवनि, and पाल who protects.
अवनिरुह: अवनिरुह m. (रुट) A tree. E. अवनि, and रुह् what mounts.
अवनिष्ठीवन: अवनिष्ठीवन n. (-नं) Spitting upon. E. अव, and निष्ठीवन spitting.
अवनी: अवनी f. (-नी) The earth: see अवनि.
अवनीपति: अवनीपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign. E. अवनी the earth, and पति a master.
अवनीश: अवनीश m. (-शः) A king. E. अवनी and ईश् lord.
अवनीश्वर: अवनीश्वर m. (-रः) A king, an emperor. E. अवनी, and ईश्वर lord.
अवनेजन: अवनेजन n. (-नं) Washing. E. अव, and नेजन ablution.
अवन्ति: अवन्ति m. (-न्तिः) 1 The name of a city, the modern Oujein. 2 The name of a river. E. अव to preserve, Uṇādi affix झिच्; the derivative is irregular. Avanti, is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus, to die at which secures eternal happiness: the word is also written अवन्ती and अवन्तिका.
अवन्तिसोम: अवन्तिसोम n. (-मं) Sour gruel, prepared from the fermentation of rice water. E. अवन्ति the city, षू to produce, मन् aff.
अवन्ती: अवन्ती f. (-न्ती) A city: see अवन्ति.
अवपतन: अवपतन n. (-नं) Alighting, descending. E. अव down, पतन falling.
अवपन्न: अवपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Alighted, descended. 2 Fallen on or into. 3 Thrown down. E. अव, and पन्न gone.
अवपात: अवपात m. (-तः) 1 A hole or pit for catching game in. 2 Descent, descending. E. अव below, पत to go or fall, घञ् aff.
अवपातन: अवपातन n. (-नं) Felling, knocking or cutting down. E. अव down, पातन causing to fall.
अवपालित: अवपालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Neglected, not protected. E. अव, before पालित protected.
अवपीड: अवपीड m. (-डः) A sternutatory, any drug producing sneezing. E. अव, पीड to pain, affix क.
अवबधा: अवबधा f. (-धा) Segment of the base of a triangle. E. अव, and बध what kills.
अवबोध: अवबोध m. (-धः) 1 Judgment, discrimination, knowledge. 2 Waking, being awake. 3 Teaching. E. अव, and बोध knowledge.
अवबोधक: अवबोधक m. (-कः) 1 A teacher. 2 An awakener. E. अव before बुध to be wise, causal form, वुन् aff.
अवबोधकत्व: अवबोधकत्व n. (-त्वं) Instruction, guidance, explanation. E. अवबोधक who teaches, and त्व aff.
अवभास: अवभास m. (-सः) 1 Light. 2 Manifestation. E. अव, and भास light.
अवभासित: अवभासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Illumined, lighted, radiant. 2 Evident, manifest. E. अव, and भासित splendid.
अवभासिन्: अवभासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Shining, bright. f. (-नी) The outer skin or cuticle. E. अव, and भासिन् what shines.
अवभिन्न: अवभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Broken, pierced, divided. E. अव affix, भिन्न cut or broken.
अवभुग्न: अवभुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Contracted, bent. E. अव, and भुग्न bent.
अवभृथ: अवभृथ m. (-थः) 1 A supplementary sacrifice made to atone for any defects in a principal and preceding one. 2 Bathing after a sacrifice. E. अव भृ to screen, क्थन् Uṇādi aff.
अवभृथस्नान: अवभृथस्नान n. (-नं) Bathing after any sacrifice or ceremony. E. अवभृथ as before, and स्नान bathing.
अवभ्रट: अवभ्रट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Flat-nosed. E. अव and भ्रटच् aff.
अवम: अवम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Low, vile, inferior, base. n. (-मं) A lunar day, exactly coinciding with a solar one. E. अव to preserve, &c. अम Uṇādi aff.
अवमत: अवमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Despised, disregarded, contemned. E. अव implying contempt, and मत known, minded.
अवमताङ्कुश: अवमताङ्कुश m. (-शः) A restive elephant, or one in rut. E. अवमत disregarded, and अङ्कुश the goad.
अवमति: अवमति m. (-तिः) A master, an owner. f. (-तिः) 1 Aversion, dislike. 2 Disregard, contempt. E. अव, मन to heed, and क्तिन् aff.
अवमन्तव्य: अवमन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be contemned, to be treated with disrespect. E. अव before मन and तव्य affix. So अवमन्य.
अवमन्तृ: अवमन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Proud, contemptuous, disrespectful. E. अव before मन, with तृच् aff.
अवमर्द: अवमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Devastation, inflicting pain or punishment on an enemy, by laying his country waste, &c. 2 Giving pain E. अव, मृद to tread down, घञ् aff.
अवमर्द्द: अवमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Devastation, inflicting pain or punishment on an enemy, by laying his country waste, &c. 2 Giving pain E. अव, मृद to tread down, घञ् aff.
अवमर्षण: अवमर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Intolerance, impatience. 2 Effacing, obliterating. 3 Banishing from recollection. E. अव away, &c. मृष to endure, ल्युट् aff.
अवमान: अवमान n. (-नं) Disrespect, contempt. E. अव before मान् respect.
अवमानता: अवमानता f. (-ता) 1 Dishonourableness. 2 Contempt. E. तल added to the last; also with त्व, अवमानत्वं.
अवमानना: अवमानना f. (-ना) Disrespect. E. अव before मन to mind, युच् affix and टाप् fem. do.
अवमाननीय: अवमाननीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be disrespected, to be contemned. E. अव before मन, with अनीयर् aff.
अवमानित: अवमानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disrespected, despised. E. अव before the part. past of मन to respect.
अवमानिता: अवमानिता f. (-ता) Disrespectfulness. E. तल् added to अवमानिन्; also with त्व, अवमानित्वं.
अवमानिन्: अवमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Behaving disrespectfully, contemning, despising. E. अवमान and इनि aff.
अवमान्य: अवमान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) To be treated with disrespect. E. अव before मन with ण्यत् aff.
अवमूत्रयत्: अवमूत्रयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Urining upon. E. अव on, मूत्र nominal v. to make water, शतृ aff.
अवमूर्द्धशय: अवमूर्द्धशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Prostrate. E. अव down, मूर्द्धन् the forehead, शय who sleeps.
अवमोचन: अवमोचन n. (-नं) Letting forth, emitting. 2 Setting at liberty. E. अव before मुच to set free, ल्युट् aff.
अवयव: अवयव m. (-वः) 1 A limb, a member. 2 A part, a portion. 3 Division of a logical argument or syllogism. E. अव, यु to join, अच् aff.
अवयविन्: अवयविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Limbed, having limbs. 2 Having portions or subdivisions. m. (-वी) A syllogism, a logical argument. E. अवयव and इनि aff.
अवर: अवर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Posterior, hinder, last. 2 Younger. 3 Inferior. n. (-रं) The hind thigh of an elephant. f. (-रा) A name of DURGĀ. E. अ neg. and वर preferable; not the best, or than which nothing is better.
अवरज: अवरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Younger, junior. 2 Inferior, of low birth. m. (-जः) A younger brother. E. अवर after, and ज born.
अवरत: अवरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stopped, ceased, desisted from. E. अव, रम to sport, affix क्त.
अवरतस्: अवरतस् ind. Hinder, posterior. E. अवर and अतसुच् aff.
अवरति: अवरति f. (-तिः) Stopping, ceasing, cessation, end. E. अव bad, &c. रम to play, and क्तिन् aff.
अवरवर्ण: अवरवर्ण mf. (-र्णः-र्णा or -र्णी) A Śūdra, a man or woman of the fourth tribe. E. अवर last, and वर्ण a tribe.
अवरवर्णक: अवरवर्णक mf. (-र्णकः-र्णिका) See the preceding. E. कन् added to अवरबर्ण, also अवरबर्णज.
अवरव्रत: अवरव्रत m. (-तः) The sun. E. अ neg. वर best, than what nought is better, and ब्रत worship: whose worship is of the first importance.
अवरस्तात्: अवरस्तात् ind. Hinder, posterior. E. अवर and अस्तात् aff.
अवरार्द्ध: अवरार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) The last half. E. अवर and अर्द्ध half.
अवरार्द्ध्य: अवरार्द्ध्य mfn. (-र्द्ध्यः-र्द्ध्या-र्द्ध्यं) Belonging to the last half. E. यत् affix to the last.
अवरीण: अवरीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Censured, blamed. E. अव, री to flow, the irregular part. past.
अवरुग्ण: अवरुग्ण mfn. (-ग्णः-ग्णा-ग्णं) Broken, torn. 2 Diseased. E. अव, before रुज to be sick, affix क्त.
अवरुद्ध: अवरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Checked, stopped, hindered. 2 Shut up or in, inclosed. 3 Secluded, as in a haram. E. अव, and रुद्ध hindered.
अवरूढ: अवरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Descended, alighted. E. अव down, रुह to go, क्त aff.
अवरोध: अवरोध m. (-धः) 1 The seraglio of a palace, the queen's apartment. 2 A queen. 3 A palace. 4 A covering. 5 Hindrance, obstruction. 6 A fence, a pen, an inclosure, confinement. 7 Restraint. E. अव, रुध to inclose or shut up, घञ् aff.
अवरोधक: अवरोधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What impedes or obstructs. m. (-कः) A guard. f. (-धिका) A female of the haram. n. (-कं) A barrier, a fence. E. अव before रोधक what opposes.
अवरोधन: अवरोधन n. (-नं) The inner or women's apartments in a royal palace. 2 Hindering, obstructing. 4 Obstacle, impediment. E. अव, रुध to enclose, ल्युट् aff.
अवरोधायन: अवरोधायन n. (-नं) A seraglio. E. अवरोध hindrance, and अयन going.
अवरोधिक: अवरोधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Obstructive, impeding. m. (-कः) A guard of the queen's apartments. E. अवरोध with ठक् aff.
अवरोधिन्: अवरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिणी-धि) Obstructing. E. अवरोध and इनि aff.
अवरोपण: अवरोपण n. (-णं) 1 Taking away, depriving, diminishing. 2 Descending. 3 Setting, (as of the sun.) E. अव affix, and रोपण placing.
अवरोपित: अवरोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Deprived of, curtailed, diminished, lost. E. अव aff. रोपित placed.
अवरोह: अवरोह m. (-हः) 1 Mounting, ascending. 2 Descent, passing from or over. 3 The growth of a creeping plant or vine. 4 A pendant branch, one that strikes fresh root into the earth, as those of the Indian fig tree. 5 Heaven or Svarga. E. अव up or down, &c. रुह to mount, घञ् aff.
